verses.raw: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.<sup foot_note=257215>1</sup> And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
verses.text: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

verses.raw: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
verses.text: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

verses.raw: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]
verses.text: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]

verses.raw: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord<sup foot_note=257218>1</sup> He will put into arduous punishment.
verses.text: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
